authority: User approved 3D pilot and matched-transport initialization/format checks; larger natural-event batches and subsequent 3D matrices require a new frozen contract.
device_scope: Uncalibrated extruded 0.25 um representative 1T1C cell; not a calibrated 90 nm device
local_reservation_policy: Existing evidence is retained. Available free space must independently cover any unconsumed old reservation plus the new operation's peak; the old reservation is not reused twice.
entry_gate: All 17 existing 2D role gates verified and old scheduler exited/released; otherwise root must separately diagnose and record an explicit release before any new solve.
after_pilot: Report measured costs and propose next frozen batch; do not run additional sources, natural-event searches, training or a new-size matrix.
